    Study settings

    Presetsプリセット

    Saves the forms, versions, words and question style you have picked now.

    Versions種類

    Each form you pick comes in the versions switched on here. Past alone gives 書いた, 書きました, 書けた… Forms with no past, negative or polite version, like the て-form, count as present, affirmative and plain.

    Words単語

    Set
    Type

    Starter set is 244 hand-picked everyday words. N5 to N1 add the JLPT vocabulary lists, N5 the easiest. Meanings and word types for JLPT words come from JMdict (EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0), and the Dictionary's example sentences from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
